test_title: PYST 185: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 26th Nov, 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c22e4649b9fefdb299722e9501f9e6e16da425f69a3552195436a7e0257201a.png]
solution:
The figure that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series is as shown below :

**Figure 1 to Figure 2 :**

 
• Star and cross rectangle in which un darken part is darken and moves one step clockwise.
 
• + moves two step clockwise and × remains in same position.

**Figure 3 to Figure 4 :**

 
• Pentagon and circle in which un darken part is darken and moves one step clockwise.
 
• + moves two step clockwise and × remains in same position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a24cca4e291633e9b69dc36334c14daf914b18135fbb92284da6780066da3fa3.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6bfe4d6ae4bcaf1a46c1efaf62907707dfd76b537d1d946939e3946a9642a30.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
